brief: logo reveal for our architecture studio
concept: The logo is built the way a building is: a grid, then lines, then light.
plan_outline: 1. Page · a fine blueprint grid draws itself across a dark ground (1.5 s)
2. Page · the logo's own lines trace along the grid, ease-out (2 s)
3. Page · a sweep of light crosses the mark; it settles (1.5 s)
4. Page · the studio's name in its typeface fades up beneath (1 s)
why: A reveal built from the brand's own shapes and craft (the grid), not a generic particle burst.
One motion language: precise, linear, ease-out; nothing bounces in an architect's identity.
The logo is prepared with the film tool's logo op first; it is never redrawn or invented.
